name: Remove webhook
description: Remove webhook Deletes a webhook. DELETE /2.0/webhooks/{webhook_id}

name: List all webhooks
description: List all webhooks Returns all defined webhooks for the requesting application. GET /2.0/webhooks
context:
GET /2.0/webhooks
Returns all defined webhooks for the requesting application. This API only returns webhooks that are applied to files or folders that are owned by the authenticated user. This means that an admin can not see webhooks created by a service account unless the admin has access to those folders, and vice versa.
Optional: marker (query) — Defines the position marker at which to begin returning results. This is used when paginating using marker-based pagination. This requires `usemarker` to be set to `true`.; limit (query) — The maximum number of items to return per page.
